title: Pairwise correlation matrix with Bonferroni-corrected significance
required_checks: Compute pairwise correlations among all numeric features and test significance with Bonferroni correction
method: Compute Pearson r and p-value for all 28 numeric-feature pairs using scipy.stats.pearsonr. Apply Bonferroni correction (alpha_adj = 0.05/28). Flag any pair surviving correction.

title: Commute-minutes distribution and outlier inspection
required_checks: Inspect commute_minutes for right-skew outliers before modeling
method: Compute skewness (scipy.stats.skew), IQR, and Tukey fence (Q3 + 1.5*IQR). Count and list outlier values. Plot histogram with KDE and overlaid boxplot.

title: Permutation feature importance and baseline model comparison
required_checks: Run a permutation-based feature importance test against performance_rating to guard against spurious fits
Check whether a baseline model (mean predictor) is statistically indistinguishable from any fitted model
method: 80/20 train-test split (random_state=42). Fit RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42) on 8 numeric features predicting performance_rating. Compute test-set R-squared. Run sklearn.inspection.permutation_importance (n_repeats=30, random_state=42) on test set. Baseline R-squared is 0 by definition of mean predictor. Report whether any feature importance mean exceeds 2 standard deviations above zero and whether model R-squared is materially > 0.

title: Salary-band group separation via Kruskal-Wallis
required_checks: Verify that salary_band levels show meaningful separation on numeric features via ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis
method: For each of the 8 numeric features, group values by salary_band and run scipy.stats.kruskal. Apply Bonferroni correction (alpha_adj = 0.05/8). Report H-statistic, raw p-value, and adjusted p-value. Generate grouped box plots.
